title: Handwired
subtitle: If-else, loops and state as matrix multiply and relu

chapters.title: Both Branches Run
chapters.blurb: An if-else becomes two ramps and a bit: both branches always compute, and one number picks the survivor.

chapters.title: A Switch of Arithmetic
chapters.blurb: A toggle switch with memory, written as comparisons, selects and a matrix power: no if, no loop.

chapters.title: The Host Loop
chapters.blurb: Waiting, listening and looping live outside the program: the host writes cells, evaluates, and reads results.

chapters.title: Loops That Cannot Stop
chapters.blurb: A fixed program cannot stop a loop early, so loops become counts, trees, tables, or the same work everywhere.

chapters.title: Exact, Trainable, Wide
chapters.blurb: Exact bits, gradients through the layers, frozen and learned weights, one program over 100,000 documents.
